instruction_summary: Re-run the paper's core geometry diagnostics (causal-inner-product orthogonality, linear subspace separation, C11 uncorrelatedness) on a 5-model ladder of 2023-2025 base LMs and produce an over-time figure showing whether the Linear Representation Hypothesis survives.

steps.description: Read replication artifacts (verdicts.json, C5/C10/C11.json, concept_g/gamma.pt) as baseline; cross-checked off-diagonal = 0.046/0.069 mean, 0.012/0.029 median
Copied replicated codebase; built uv venv with torch==2.13.0 transformers==5.16.1 (supports qwen3+olmo3)
steps.command: cp -r ../../replication/codebase workspace/codebase; uv venv && uv pip install torch==2.13.0 transformers==5.16.1 accelerate numpy seaborn matplotlib tqdm sentencepiece scipy

steps.description: Adapted store_matrices/linear_rep_geometry (Auto* loaders, bf16, fp32 eigh, tokenizer-agnostic single_token_id) into run_model.py; computed metrics for all 5 models
steps.command: for k in llama2-7b llama3.1-8b qwen2.5-7b qwen3-8b-base olmo3-7b; do python run_model.py $k; done

steps.description: Cross-check gate: Llama-2 recomputed here = 0.046/0.069 mean, 0.012/0.029 median (matches on-disk exactly)
Aggregated intersection (22 concepts viable in all 5) + built required over-time figure
Optional C8 intervention: 'Long live the' + alpha*(male=>female) rank table per model

key_results.verdict: The Linear Representation Hypothesis SURVIVES to 2023-2025 models: causal inner product more orthogonal than Euclidean on all 5, all viable binary single-token concepts show linear subspace structure, C11 and C8 hold everywhere.

comparison_to_original.note: Stays low (approx orthogonal) across all generations; Llama-2 recomputed value reproduces the on-disk number exactly.
Survives (>1) everywhere; ~1.5x for LLaMA lineage but weakens to ~1.25x for Qwen/OLMo, below the paper's 1.5-2.5x band.
Llama-2's sole exception thing=>part (d=0.85) matches the paper; newer models separate all viable concepts.

comparison_to_original.followup: separable |r|<=0.03 and non-separable r approx 0.37 on all 5 models
comparison_to_original.note: Sanity check holds identically across the ladder.

comparison_to_original.original: flips top-1 by alpha=0.2, king out of top-5 by alpha=0.3
comparison_to_original.note: Causal male=>female steering still works on every generation.

deviations: Viability gate (>=10 single-token pairs) yields a 22-concept intersection; Llama-2 has 22 viable concepts (5 morphological concepts dropped for lack of single-token pairs), so its subspace count reads 21/22 vs the replication's 26/27 (which used all 27 with no gate). The all-27 orthogonality anchor 0.046/0.069 is still reproduced exactly.

The paper's '1.5-2.5x' orthogonality-advantage band is met by the LLaMA models (~1.5x) but not by Qwen2.5/Qwen3/OLMo-3 (~1.22-1.31x); reported honestly, the causal metric still improves orthogonality (ratio>1) but by a smaller margin.
Optional C6 measurement probe (forward passes over Wikipedia contexts) was not run to stay inside GPU budget; optional C8 intervention WAS run (cheap, one forward pass per model).
